newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak cbank sets three-day repo, min rate 8.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak cbank sets three-day repo, min rate 8.8 pct.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) on Friday set a three-day repo tender to add market liquidity of a fixed volume of 3.5 billion crowns.
Minimum rate in the tender was set at 8.8 percent, equal to the discount rate, a central bank statement said.
The NBS added one billion crowns to the local money market through a one-day repo tender on Thursday at an average yield of 18.60 percent.
Average yield in a central bank one-week repo on Wednesday was 17.62 percent.
The NBS monitors market liquidity on a daily basis and decides each morning whether to hold any open market operations.
According to NBS figures, the Slovak banking sector as of July 10 lacked some 0.94 percent of the funds needed to meet minimum reserves requirements on July 15.
